versions.content: The SW-Component template shall support propagation of mode information 27 of 57  AUTOSAR CONFIDENTIAL  Document ID 212: AUTOSAR_RS_SoftwareComponentTemplate Requirements on Software Component Template AUTOSAR CP R19-11 Type: valid Description: A mode can affect SWCs located on several ECUs. Therefore by configuration the mode information must be propagated to several ECUs. Rationale: See "Vehicle and Application Mode Management Concept". Use Case: All use cases which require controlling the basic software and runnable control. Dependencies: [RS_SWCT_03200] Supporting Material: 
